items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I'd meet all the personalities that came in, including Yul Brynner

ctx.x: I could be behind the mike, you know, And so I went over and took the course and -- as class producer, had all the qualifications of becoming a director, which was my ambition. But I would have settled for anything then except a grip.

So I was working at the Blue Angel at the time, and I was going to school during the day. And I'd meet all the personalities that came in, including Yul Brynner, and we were talking about Mike Levine. And he used to come in, all the TV guys, people, you know, and a lot of directors.

So I was invited in a clients' booth to all the major shows like Montgomery Presents and Studio One and the Perry Como show I used to catch every day coming home from school, because I knew the musical contractor, and I could sit in and listen to the directions.
